title: Rational Ensemble Logic for Cohort Discovery with Real-World Electrophysiology Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.23708v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Biomedical knowledge representation should make the passage from observations to conclusions transparent, rigorous, understandable, explainable, and reproducible (TRUER). We introduce Rational Ensemble Logic (QEL) for specifying temporal phenotypes in real-world electrophysiology data (RWED), with a meaning independent of the implementation software. QEL combines three parameterized modal operators (exact displacement, bounded existence, and bounded universality) over rational time with Boolean connectives and first-order quantification. Its Labeled Interval Ensemble (LINE) semantics represents annotated records as finite interval ensembles. We relate the operators to morphological operations and develop endpoint-array algorithms and finite rational evidence sets for model checking. We prove closure and semantic correctness of the interval operations, obtain finite evidence sets by quantifier elimination, and establish polynomial data

translated_title: 面向真实世界电生理数据队列发现的有理集成逻辑
translated_abstract: 生物医学知识表示应当使从观察到结论的过程具有透明性、严谨性、可理解性、可解释性和可复现性（TRUER）。我们提出了有理集成逻辑，用于在真实世界电生理数据中规范时序表型，其语义独立于具体实现软件。QEL 将有理数时间轴上的三个参数化模态算子（精确位移、有界存在、有界全称）与布尔连接词和一阶量词相结合。其标注区间集成语义将有标注的记录表示为有限的区间集成。我们将这些算子与形态学运算相关联，并开发了端点数组算法和有限有理证据集用于模型检测。我们证明了区间运算的封闭性和语义正确性，通过量词消去获得有限证据集，并建立了多项式数据复杂度。
tldr: 本文提出了有理集成逻辑（QEL），一种语义独立于软件实现的时序表型规范语言，可用于真实世界电生理数据的队列发现，并配有可证明正确性的区间运算、模型检测算法和有限证据集。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Rational Ensemble Logic (QEL), a software-independent temporal logic for specifying temporal phenotypes in real-world electrophysiology data, equipped with provably correct interval operations, model checking algorithms, and finite evidence sets to enable transparent, rigorous, and reproducible cohort discovery.
